message: Verdant 15.4.0 is available through VCC. Update Verdant World System, then run the V15.4 Supporter Scroll + Clock Sync Fix once in Unity.
notes: Supporter/member name lists no longer snap back to the top during runtime refreshes.
Main Board and iPad clock displays now use one shared local clock controller.
Changing 12/24-hour format propagates to all linked Verdant clock displays.
Clock output uses local machine time instead of a manual UTC offset, avoiding daylight-saving drift.
The V15.4 installer makes a scene backup before changing references.
